Third-party architecture and pretrained-asset provenance

e4e / StyleGAN2
https://github.com/omertov/encoder4editing
Code license: e4e/LICENSE. Native tensor operators are implemented in runtime.py.

SimSwap ArcFace
https://github.com/neuralchen/SimSwap
Code license: SimSwap_LICENSE.

3DDFA-V2
https://github.com/cleardusk/3DDFA_V2
Code license: tddfa/LICENSE. Small normalization metadata is included.

2D-FAN / face-alignment
https://github.com/1adrianb/face-alignment
Source commit: 608505febb47082eb83c2e54254294b3044d976f
Included source: fan/fan.py. License: fan/LICENSE (BSD-3-Clause).
The wrapper uses only eyelid and lip opening ratios, not full identity shape matching.

L2CS-Net
https://github.com/Ahmednull/L2CS-Net
Source commit: a4d8f7fa5436a2b2b9f088471623b552a85811bd
Included source: l2cs/model.py. License: l2cs/LICENSE (MIT).
Weights: py-feat/l2cs, revision 241076966f03b197773ce75d23adc60299473ccd,
https://huggingface.co/py-feat/l2cs
The original implementation license does not grant all rights to checkpoint
redistribution or commercial use. See l2cs/WEIGHT-LICENSE-NOTICE.md for the
Gaze360 checkpoint's research/noncommercial restrictions. Weight files are
not published to this repository; users obtain them from their original sources.
This coursework package uses the fixed checkpoint and the probed head ordering
with horizontal-flip ensembling. Predictions are proxies, not true gaze angles.

YuNet
https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/main/models/face_detection_yunet
Pretrained file: face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx, renamed yunet.onnx.

All neural networks stay frozen. Large pretrained files are excluded from Git.
Exact file sizes, SHA256 digests and acquisition links: ../model_manifest.json.
